lead: `bun nv try` runs a case's `--FILE nvs.toml--` section as Novis source, so a probe that needs a `[limits]` ceiling fails to compile.
body: `tools/nv/cmd/try.ts` reads `--TEST--`, `--FILE--` and `--ORACLE--` and nothing else, and `nvs run` takes `./nvs.toml` from the working directory, never from beside the script. Write `main.nvs` and `nvs.toml` into one directory under `.agent-tmp/` and run the pipeline's `nvs` with that directory as the working directory.
